nary_nodes.label: Deadly Russian attack on Kyiv
evidence: Ukraine’s capital Kyiv came under a deadly Russian attack early Monday morning

nary_nodes.label: Casualties from Monday attack
evidence: killing at least 19 people in the city and eight others in the surrounding region, with dozens more wounded

nary_nodes.label: Damage in Kyiv from Monday attack
evidence: Residential buildings were badly damaged in the assault, leaving people trapped in multi-storey apartment blocks. An entire family was killed and pulled from the rubble, while cars were seen burning on city streets.

nary_nodes.label: Klitschko reports destruction and damage
evidence: There was “destruction and damage” in four districts of the city, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said, adding that the Podilsky district was hit the hardest.

nary_nodes.label: Evacuation of residents
evidence: Rescuers evacuated residents, including children, from the upper floors of a damaged building in the district early Monday

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky warns of new massive strike
evidence: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky had warned just hours earlier that Moscow was “preparing a new massive strike,”

nary_nodes.label: Ferocious Russian attack on Kyiv
evidence: a ferocious Russian attack on Kyiv killed 30 people last Thursday

nary_nodes.label: Casualties from Thursday attack
evidence: killed 30 people last Thursday

nary_nodes.label: Third-deadliest attack on capital
evidence: the third-deadliest attack on the capital since the war began.

nary_nodes.label: UN reports higher civilian casualties in 2026
evidence: Civilian casualties in 2026 are “significantly higher” than during the same period in 2025, the UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine said in a Monday statement.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky on Putin's attack timing
evidence: “This is typical of Putin: right after America’s Independence Day and before the NATO Summit in Ankara,” Zelensky said Sunday in a post on X ahead of the attack.

nary_nodes.label: Critical NATO summit
evidence: on the eve of a critical NATO summit in Turkey

nary_nodes.label: Lethality of Russian assaults on Kyiv
evidence: The lethality of the Russian assaults on Kyiv in the past week displays the challenge Ukraine faces in protecting its capital as Russia innovates and steps up its attacks.

nary_nodes.label: Ballistic missiles not shot down
evidence: None of the ballistic missiles fired at Ukraine on Monday were shot down by air defenses

nary_nodes.label: Air force reports missiles and drones struck locations
evidence: according to data from its air force, which said 29 ballistic missiles and 18 attack drones had struck 34 locations across the country.

nary_nodes.label: Air force reports missiles and drones launched
evidence: More than 350 drones and 66 missiles were launched toward Ukraine, with Kyiv the main target, it said.

nary_nodes.label: Power outages across regions
evidence: Monday’s attacks led to power outages across a number of regions in Ukraine

nary_nodes.label: Electricity agency reports power outages
evidence: the country’s electricity transmission agency said.

nary_nodes.label: Russia's defense ministry states targets and reason
evidence: Russia’s defense ministry said it used “high-precision, long-range weapons” to target military-industrial facilities and fuel and energy sites in Kyiv on Monday. It said the attacks were in response to Ukrainian attacks on civilian infrastructure in Russian territory.

nary_nodes.label: Ukrainian military strikes oil refinery
evidence: On Monday, the Ukrainian military said it struck Russia’s largest oil refinery, in a long range strike more than 2,500 kilometres from the Ukrainian border.

nary_nodes.label: Russia suffering major fuel crisis
evidence: it comes as Russia is suffering a major fuel crisis amid Ukraine’s campaign of drone strikes on its energy infrastructure.

nary_nodes.label: Trump and Zelensky spoke on phone
evidence: The pair spoke on the phone on Saturday.

nary_nodes.label: Trump and Putin held call
evidence: Trump then offered again to help end the war on Sunday during a nearly 90-minute call with Russian President Vladimir Putin

nary_nodes.label: Russia's foreign ministry reports Trump-Putin call
evidence: according to Russia’s foreign ministry.

nary_nodes.label: Trump vowed to solve war
evidence: The US president had vowed to solve the war within 24 hours of taking office for a second time

nary_nodes.label: Administration failed to find path to peace
evidence: but more than 500 days into his current term, the administration has yet to find a path to peace between the neighbors, despite multiple attempts.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky renews plea for Patriot missiles
evidence: Ahead of the summit, Zelensky is using the attacks on Kyiv to renew his plea for allies to supply Ukraine with missiles for Patriot systems.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky on insufficient Patriot supply
evidence: The “insufficient supply of interceptor missiles” was the reason Ukraine was unable to shoot down any ballistic missiles in Monday’s assault, Zelensky said in a statement.

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky calls for strong air defense decisions
evidence: “It is critically important that the world – first and foremost the United States and our European partners – come out of the NATO Summit in Ankara with strong decisions in support of our air defense,” he said

nary_nodes.label: Zelensky on Patriot stockpiles encouraging Russia
evidence: “As long as Patriot missiles remain in our allies’ stockpiles, Russia is only encouraged to keep ‘vanquishing’ residential buildings,” he added.

nary_nodes.label: Von der Leyen states urgent air defense need
evidence: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said that the country “urgently needs more air defence. We will discuss it this week in Ankara at the @NATO Summit.”

nary_nodes.label: Patriot interceptor capabilities
evidence: The latest versions of Patriot interceptors are capable of engaging incoming short-range ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones at altitudes up to 15 kilometers (9.3 miles) and distances of up to 35 kilometers.

nary_nodes.label: Geran-4 drone characteristics
evidence: Geran-4 jet-powered drones –– which fly too fast for Kyiv’s mobile fire groups and can only be shot down with ground-to-air missiles or fighter jets.

nary_nodes.label: Russian forces step up efforts in Donetsk
evidence: Russian forces have also stepped up efforts to take more of Ukraine’s eastern Donetsk region

nary_nodes.label: Ukraine ramps up attacks on Russian territory
evidence: Ukraine, meantime, has also recently ramped up missile and drone attacks against key infrastructure deep inside Russian territory

nary_nodes.label: TASS reports Russia shot down Ukrainian drones
evidence: Russia shot down 519 Ukrainian drones launched toward it overnight into Monday, the state news agency TASS reported.

nary_nodes.label: Russia's war in Ukraine
evidence: Russia’s war in Ukraine will form the backdrop to the NATO summit this week in Turkey
